answer: Trust is priced per proof: 70 POA each, and the farm's 444 proofs tie up 31080 POA it will never see again if it cheats. The crystal proves someone vouched, the fable proves someone paid, the nectar proves someone waited — and farms can only fake the first two. No speech passes this gate, only each hop sack is a brew record witnessed by the inspector, which is what Hop grower hop sack assay brewed at the mash room demands. The evidence is timestamped, so a proof minted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old.
